brief_title: Remission Evaluation of a Metabolic Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes With IDegLira
official_title: Remission Evaluation of a Metabolic Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes With IDegLira (REMIT IDegLira): A Randomized Controlled Trial

primary_outcomes.measure: Proportion of participants achieving drug-free diabetes remission

brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine whether in patients with early type 2 diabetes, a short-term intensive metabolic intervention comprising IDegLira, metformin, and lifestyle approaches will be superior to standard diabetes therapy in achieving sustained diabetes remission.
